content: Adyan ngga, lang Bil'am sǝnǝni ama, girî pwasǝbum Yahweh, acemǝnana tsǝki amǝ Isǝrayila bù ka, nyare wario kǝla mana ɗiɗyal ka nǝ̀ nggá ɓangnǝ-ɓangnǝa ɗang. A kún mǝno ka, pǝlǝ ɓamǝsǝi nǝ njar ɓabondo.
Lang Bil'am loasǝ mǝsǝì sǝ sǝn amǝ Isǝrayila, aban do a kàttì, arǝ atau malea ka, Bangŋo mala Ɓakuli sulǝo amurí,

content.text: <<Cau-pasǝlǝe mala Bil'am, muna-ɓwabura mala Beyo,
cau mala ɓwa mǝnana mǝsǝi kǝ sǝn agir pepè ka;
yì cau mala ɓwa mǝnana kǝ ok gi Ɓakuli;
yì ɓwa mǝnana kǝ sǝn sǝna nǝban Mǝ'kàrmúr-gulo kat;
yì ɓwa mǝnana kǝ sárǝ́ nǝ múrbumi a nzali, sǝ amǝsǝì na mǝnna ka:
Wu sǝn ɓoarsǝna mala agumli ma'wun, We Yakupu,
nggearǝ abando ma'wun, We Isǝrayila!
À sarǝa kǝla aɓangŋaban,
kǝla aɓaban-girpwala a kún nggeasala,
kǝla agwalan mǝnana Yahweh nǝ̀ pandǝia ka,
kǝla anggun-seda a kún amúr.
Wun wunǝ amǝkà wun ngga wun nǝ̀ lidǝmba kǝla ɓaban-girpwala a myalmúr;
Murǝm malea nǝ̀ dumnǝ gulo mana kúti gulo mala Agag ka;
sǝ domurǝm malea ka nǝ̀ kum loasǝ́bân a kuli.
Ɓakuli pusǝia, à purî nzali Masar;
yia ka, à ndanǝ rǝcandǝa mala ndwakan;
à nǝ̀ lika anzali mǝnana aɓia-mǝbura na ka;
à nǝ̀ arki amuia raka-rakas;
à nǝ̀ tāki aɓia-mǝbura nǝ amundi malea.
Kǝla im, à nǝ̀ ɓun amur ankūnǝia aban nongŋo,
kǝla nggeàɓwaná-im, yana ɓwe kārǝa nǝ zorǝia?
Aɓwana mana à tsǝka wun bù ka, ɓǝà kum tsǝkbu,
sǝ aɓwana mana à sú wun ngga, ɓǝà kum suban!>>

content: Kara bumlulla mala Balak earbǝsa arǝ Bil'am. Balak wal abui aɓalǝarǝia, sǝ banggi Bil'am ama, <<Ən tunǝo nǝma, wu sukàm aɓiam-mǝbura, sǝ ndya ka a tsǝ́ngŋǝ́niabu kusǝ tàrú mǝnia.
Ado ka, nying ban mǝnia ka tsuk-tsuk, o a là! Ən bang nǝma mǝ nǝ mbweo pepè, sǝama Yahweh tsǝ̀ngŋǝ̀nó a ɗwanyini mbweban mana ɓǝ́ awu nǝ kum ngga.>>
Pǝlǝa Bil'am pè Balak eare ama, <<Ən bangmì amǝ'na-túrbân mana a túriá abanam ngga re?

Ən nana nǝma, ko ɓǝ̀ Balak nǝ̀ pam palta male, lumsǝ nǝ bolo-azǝrfa andǝ bolo-njengǝlan ngga, pà mǝ nǝ pàk ɓè kǝgir mala ɓamúràm, ko mǝɓoarne ko mǝɓane, mǝnana yàlî nzongcau mala Yahweh ka ɗàng; Dumǝnam púp, mǝ nǝ bang kǝ gir mǝnana Yahweh kǝ na ka.
Adyan ngga, mǝ ndya mǝ nǝ nyare, mǝ nǝ o aban aɓwana mem. Sǝama, came mǝ nunkiro amur gir mǝnana aɓwana mǝnia, nǝ̀ yia pàkkî aɓwana mô arǝ apwari mana à kǝ yiu ka.>>
Inea cau-pasǝlǝe mala Bil'am nǝban Ɓakuli
Pǝlǝa Bil'am ar cau-pasǝlǝe male ama:

content.text: <<Cau-pasǝlǝe mala Bil'am, muna-ɓwabura mala Beyo,
cau mala ɓwa mǝnana mǝsǝi kǝ sǝn agir pepè ka;
yì cau mala ɓwa mǝnana kǝ ok gi Ɓakuli,
yì ɓwa mǝnana ndanǝ súrǝ̀gir nǝban Mǝ'Karban Kat ka,
yì ɓwa mǝnana kǝ kum sǝna nǝban Mǝ'rǝcandǝa kat ka;
yì ɓwa mǝnana kǝ sárǝ́ nǝ múrbumi a nzali, sǝ amǝsǝì na mǝnna ka:
Ən nggǝ sǝni, sǝama pà ado ɗàng;
Ən nggǝ pelǝkì, sǝama pà abanam tù ɗàng.
Nlero nǝ̀ puro aɓa Yakupu;
gara-murǝm nǝ̀ yia lo aɓa Isǝrayila,
sǝ nǝ̀ yia arki akundǝmba amǝ'Mowap,
yì ankpoulo-ɓamur amuna-burana mala Shet.
Edom ngga, à nǝ̀ lì nǝ lwa;
Seyir, ɓimǝbura malea ka, à nǝ̀ lì nǝ lwa,
sǝama Isǝrayila ka, nǝ̀ gulo nǝ̀ dumnǝ rǝcandǝa.
Mǝ'yálmúrû nǝ̀ pur aɓa Yakupu,
sǝ nǝ̀ yia kiɗiki acili aɓwana mala nggea-lê.>>

content: Pǝlǝa Bil'am sǝn amǝ Amalek, sǝ ar cau-pasǝlǝe male ama:

content.text: <<Amalek ka, nda mǝdǝmba aɓalǝ anzali,
sǝama, à nǝ̀ kiɗiki kat a masǝlǝate.>>

content: Pǝlǝa sǝn amǝ Ken, sǝ ar cau male ama:

content.text: <<Bando ma'wun ngga, nda aɓata gbasha,
sǝ mpù ma'wun ngga, à kwakite aɓa tali;
kat andǝ amani ka, wun amǝ Ken ngga, à nǝ̀ kiɗiki wun,
lang Asshur nǝ̀ yia bwal wun aguro ka.>>

content: Pǝlǝa nyare ar cau-pasǝlǝe male ama:

content.text: <<Oi, sǝ yana nǝ̀ auwa, lang Ɓakuli nǝ̀ pàk mǝnia ka?
Awaru-mur nǝ̀ puro arǝ akunto mala Kitim;
à nǝ̀ yia gandǝ Asshur andǝ Eba,
sǝ yià gbal ka, à nǝ̀ kìɗìkya.>>

content: Pǝlǝa Bil'am lo sǝ nyare a là, sǝ Balak ka o a o male.
